Dear Appeals Unit:

We request that you overturn the denial of claim 6268311 and approve payment for CPT 72148, MRI lumbar spine without contrast, date of service 2026-06-18, billed amount $2,052.88. The denial (CO-50 / RARC N386) states that the clinical information submitted did not demonstrate that the service met the plan's medical necessity criteria (source: denial_letter.txt). The clinical record below demonstrates that all three medical-necessity criteria of policy MP-IMG-007 are satisfied.

Criterion 2.1(a) — At least 6 weeks of conservative therapy prior to the MRI request, documented in the medical record.
- The physical therapy attendance log documents a treatment period of 2026-03-23 to 2026-06-04 (73 days) with 21 visits completed, exceeding the 6-week (42-day) requirement (source: supporting/pt_log.txt).
- The primary care visit note of 2026-03-23 documents initiation of conservative management: NSAIDs, a home exercise program, and a physical therapy referral (source: notes/2026-03-23_pcp.txt).
- The primary care follow-up note of 2026-04-13 documents ongoing physical therapy (~14 days at that visit) with continued conservative management (source: notes/2026-04-13_pcp_followup.txt).
Status: MET.

Criterion 2.1(b) — A neurological deficit or a recognized red flag finding documented in the clinical record.
- The orthopedic consultation note of 2026-06-04 documents a neurological deficit: "Left ankle dorsiflexion strength is mildly reduced," along with left leg paresthesias and a positive straight leg raise at 40 degrees (source: notes/2026-06-04_ortho.txt).
Status: MET.

Criterion 2.1(c) — No prior imaging of the same lumbar spine region within the preceding 12 months.
- The orthopedic consultation note of 2026-06-04 states: "Imaging history: No prior lumbar imaging on file" (source: notes/2026-06-04_ortho.txt).
Status: MET.

The date of service (2026-06-18) follows the orthopedic consultation of 2026-06-04 at which the lumbar spine MRI was ordered (source: notes/2026-06-04_ortho.txt). All supporting documentation predates or coincides with the date of service; no post-service note is relied upon as evidence for the service.

This appeal is timely. The appeal deadline is 180 days from the denial notice date of 2026-07-17, which is 2027-01-13 (source: denial_letter.txt; policy MP-IMG-007 section 7.1). This appeal is submitted on 2026-08-04, well within the window.

Specific remedy requested: Overturn denial code CO-50 and approve/remit payment for CPT 72148 (MRI lumbar spine without contrast), date of service 2026-06-18, billed amount $2,052.88.
